content_sections.heading: PGIMER Senior Resident Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the PGIMER Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download PGIMER Senior Resident Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Senior Resident Age Limit 2026

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PGIMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment is 13 August 2026. Candidates are encouraged to attend the walk-in interview on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident posts at PGIMER.

faq.question: Q3. What are the required qualifications for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.B.B.S. degree from a recognized University and an M.D. (Radiodiagnosis) degree or its equivalent from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in venue.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Chandigarh. The specific venue details can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a regular or ad-hoc position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Senior Resident position is Ad-hoc.
